entities.summary: Azat Abdullin (b. 1931-06-26, Bashkirskaya Urginka) was a journalist or media commentator of the Modern era, defined by industrialization, revolution, and global conflict, active in Bashkirskaya Urginka. Known in the fields of poets & playwrights.
